issue_context.title: Handle incompatible meta when recovering a table referring a policy
comments:
I like option (1).

i.e. In the case of `drop table t; drop placement policy p1; create placement policy p1 ..; recover table t` I do not think it is correct to refer to the original policy p1.

review_comments: I don't understand. If the policy is dropped, this function returns an error and the operation fails. How does it solve your problem?

We cannot drop a policy which is used by other tables. So when the table is dropped or truncated, the policy must exists. We are using a snapshot meta here with the version where the table has not dropped yet, so we can still get the  policy even if it is dropped now
You can check the test cases. I've added some tests there.
